$description: GovKit semantic spacing roles (DTCG 2025.10). Each role has a phone value (`base`) and a desktop value (`md`, from the md breakpoint: a container query on the app column in the app); inset roles have both axes (`x` inline, `y` block). `$value` is Today (the default rendering, the modal Today value of the role); the preview modes are in the `modes` extension. Generated into src/theme/tokens/spacing.css; see spacing.config.json and design-system/tokens/spacing.decisions.md.

inset-tight.$description: Padding of a small inline box: a chip that is not a Tag, code, a tooltip, a compact popover menu, an icon wrapper. New 4 on both axes (decision 0: the x places tie between 2 and 4 and 4 keeps the menu popover's 8 within the budget; y follows x so the box stays even).

inset-item.$description: Padding of one item among peers that steps up on desktop: data list rows, accordion headers and bodies, selectable cards, definition list rows.

inset-item-flat.$description: Padding of one item among peers that keeps one size at every width: menu items, list rows inside menus and pickers, compact rows (split from inset-item by decision 0: 15 x and 23 y places keep one value).

inset-surface.$description: Padding of a standalone surface that steps up on desktop: card, panel, dialog header/body/footer, alert, empty state.

inset-surface-flat.$description: Padding of a small standalone surface that keeps one size: popovers, menus, compact cards and boxes (split from inset-surface by decision 0: 21 x and 19 y places keep one value).

inset-surface-wide.$description: Padding of a large panel that is 24 px at every width: aside cards, the p-6 cards and settings panels (split from inset-surface by decision 0: 24→24 is 8 px from the stepped role on phone; 19 Card call sites use p-6).

inset-page.$description: Page gutters and the page block padding: Container, page main/content, page header, footer, top bars.

inset-flush.$description: Padding that only spaces siblings: a text line or wrapper with no background, border or click target that carries padding in Today (owner rule: padding never takes a gap role, and no stacked spacing). New is zero: the parent's gap carries the space. Its exceptions keep the exact Today padding and are exempt from the New change budget (config budgetExemptRoles).

gap-tight.$description: Between the parts of one element: icon and label, title and subtitle lines, value and unit, items of one inline cluster.

gap-phrase.$description: Between the inline text fragments of one phrase laid out as flex children: a value and its unit (48.53M ARA), a count and its noun, "5 days" + "left to vote", a label and its status ("Minimum participation" + "not reached"). It is word spacing, not layout, so it is density-invariant: New, looser and compact all keep Today's dominant value (4; the 2 px places are the exception gap-phrase--fixed-2). Phrase rows also wrap (flex-wrap) so a long phrase breaks onto a second line instead of splitting into columns.

gap-related.$description: Between the parts of one item or field: label and field, avatar and its text block, item header and its lines, a field and its action.

gap-group.$description: Between peers that keep one gap at every width: items of a list, fields of a form, buttons of a group, a card title row and its content.

gap-group-stepped.$description: Between peers that space out on desktop: card grids, page-level lists, form sections inside a page (split from gap-group by decision 0: 28 places step 16→24).

gap-section.$description: Between the sections of a dialog, an aside or a wizard step (24 at every width).

gap-section-stepped.$description: Between sections that space out on desktop: wizard steps, settings forms, governance setup sections (split from gap-section by decision 0: 10 places step 24 to 32-48 at md, the L1-optimal md value is 40).

gap-section-wide.$description: Between the main sections of a page and its large blocks (40 at every width; split from gap-section by decision 0: 11 places).

gap-layout.$description: Between page columns (main and aside) and the top-level blocks of a landing page.

inset-nav.$description: Navigation chrome (owner decision 6): padding of the app shell around the navigation: the sidebar panel, the top and mobile header bars, the mobile nav menu. New = Today snapped to the scale; looser and compact move one scale step.

inset-nav-item.$description: Navigation chrome: padding of a navigation link, a nav group label, the account and workspace pickers of the sidebar. New = Today snapped; x moves one scale step in looser and compact, y stays (a step on every link would add 8 px per link and push the sidebar footer out of view at 1440).

inset-nav-bar.$description: Navigation chrome: padding of the top and mobile header bars and the mobile nav menu. Their height is set by their controls; their padding is Today snapped and does not change with density (a bar may change height by at most 4 px between Today and any mode).

gap-nav-tight.$description: Navigation chrome: between the parts of one nav element (icon and label, the links of one group).

gap-nav-related.$description: Navigation chrome: between the parts of one nav block (header bar items, footer lines, sidebar header rows).

gap-nav-group.$description: Navigation chrome: between nav groups and blocks of the sidebar.

gap-nav-section.$description: Navigation chrome: between the top-level parts of the sidebar (header, links, footer).
